items.title: W.W. Grainger’s (NYSE:GWW) Q3 2026 sales top estimates, full-year outlook slightly exceeds expectations
items.summary: Maintenance and repair supplier W.W. Grainger (NYSE:GWW) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 11.3% year on year to $5.18 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $19.9 billion at the midpoint came in 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.54 per share was 7.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
